rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the task-based difficulty guidance, adjusting for approach fit and tension; higher targets make success harder and prompt greater use of fate points and assistance.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: A spell requires a magic-practitioner aspect, a high Lore skill, and access to words. Each word has three power levels; practitioners can use the first, Student of Magic grants the second level across all words, and Master of Magic grants the third.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Magic (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default access is the first level; a setting can widen access through study or mastery, paid for with character choices.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: Build a spell by choosing applicable words and adding each word's level value to its difficulty; if the desired effect exceeds the caster's available level, use the next higher level, or add +4 if even the third level cannot do it. Casting costs a fate point and a Lore roll; failure either refunds the point with no effect or causes the effect with unforeseen consequences, a tie causes minor unforeseen consequences, success works, and success with style lets one word act as though one level higher.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Casting a Spell (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default casting uses additive word difficulty and a fate-point cost; a world can change the price or consequence of failure, with risk and expenditure limiting spell use.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: A book or material component can provide spell bonuses as an aspect; a free invocation on either can pay the fate-point cost instead. Components are usually one-use boosts.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Books and Material Components (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default is a spell bonus or one-time payment substitute; a setting can make components rarer or more durable, with access to magical supplies as the limiting cost.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: Unless words modify it, a spell affects the caster or a touched mortal, lasts only while the caster can see the target, has no special effect, and provides Mediocre (+0) opposition. Casting against an unwilling creature adds its Will to the opposition.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — The Default Spell (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default spells are local, short-lived, and low opposition; a world can loosen range or duration through added words, paying in difficulty and possibly resistance.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: A command spell places a boost usable to compel the target, which may resist by giving the caster a fate point; at the second level it instead places a situation aspect with one free invocation. At the third level, a resisting target takes a mental consequence in its lowest available slot.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Command (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default commands give limited leverage; a setting can strengthen them to inflict mental harm, with resistance and increasing casting difficulty as the cost.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: Distance increases targeting reach from touch to sight at level one, to a sympathetic token at any range at level two, and to any target whose name the caster can speak at level three.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Distance (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default reach is touch; a world can permit remote targeting through sight, tokens, or names, with the relevant connection or knowledge as the limit.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: Knowledge magic yields truthful, helpful answers and a boost for each answer: one question at level one, two at level two, or three at level three. Without Time or Distance, questions concern only the present and immediate surroundings.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Knowledge (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default inquiry is local and present-focused; a world can extend its scope with other words, while question count and spell difficulty limit certainty.
rules.licence: CC-BY-3.0/4.0 or OGL as each book states

rules.statement: Luck magic places a boost that can produce a small boon or inconvenience at level one; level two permits major boons or setbacks and self-targeting, often with unforeseen consequences. Level three allows virtually unlimited changes to the target's fortune and nearly reliable self-targeting.
locators: Fate SRD (Core, Condensed, Accelerated, toolkits): Words of Power — Luck (fate-srd#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default luck changes are modest and cannot target the caster; a world can allow major or near-unlimited fortune shifts at higher levels, risking unintended outcomes.

rules.statement: Movement magic grants ground movement or changes speed at level one, gives a new mode of movement at level two, and relocates a thing immediately at level three.
